toolbar.enablePointCreation: Enable point creation — empty clicks on the floor plan will create measurements
toolbar.disablePointCreation: Disable point creation — empty clicks on the floor plan will no longer create measurements

emptyState.noFloorPlans: This survey has no floor plans yet.

deleteFloorPlan.title: Delete floor plan
deleteFloorPlan.body_one: Delete "{{name}}"? This will also remove its 1 measurement point (with its readings). {{cannot}}
deleteFloorPlan.body_other: Delete "{{name}}"? This will also remove its {{count}} measurement points (with their readings). {{cannot}}

replaceImage.title: Replace image
replaceImage.bodyDimChanged: Replace the image of "{{name}}"? The new image has different dimensions ({{oldW}}×{{oldH}} → {{newW}}×{{newH}}). {{cannot}}
replaceImage.repositionHint_one: "Auto-reposition" moves the 1 existing point proportionally to the new image; "Adjust image manually" keeps the points in place and lets you position the new image underneath them.
replaceImage.repositionHint_other: "Auto-reposition" moves the {{count}} existing points proportionally to the new image; "Adjust image manually" keeps the points in place and lets you position the new image underneath them.
replaceImage.calibrationHint: Auto-reposition removes the scale calibration (recalibrate later); manual adjustment preserves the current calibration.

alignEditor.title: Adjust image manually
alignEditor.hint: Drag the image to position it and use +/− to adjust the size until it matches the existing points (shown below). The points don't move.

resetPoints.title: Reset points
resetPoints.body_one: Remove the 1 point on this floor plan and its readings? {{cannot}}
resetPoints.body_other: Remove all {{count}} points on this floor plan and their readings? {{cannot}}

bulkMove.title: Move all points
bulkMove.body_one: Move the 1 point on this floor plan{{distance}}? {{cannot}}
bulkMove.body_other: Move the {{count}} points on this floor plan{{distance}}? {{cannot}}

deleteVertex.title: Delete vertex
deleteVertex.body_one: This vertex is used by 1 wall. Deleting it will also remove that wall. {{cannot}}
deleteVertex.body_other: This vertex is used by {{count}} walls. Deleting it will also remove those walls. {{cannot}}

calibrate.title: Calibrate scale
calibrate.distanceLabel: Real distance between the two clicked points (in meters)

newFloorPlan.title: New survey
newFloorPlan.blankImageHint: Without an image, the floor plan is born blank (~40 m × 30 m, pre-calibrated) for drawing the terrain edges.
newFloorPlan.csvHint: Re-creates the points from a consolidated CSV (exported per floor plan or per survey) — positions only make sense if the image above matches the original export (image required).
newFloorPlan.rescaledHint_one: 1 point will be repositioned proportionally — the source floor plan has different dimensions than the image chosen above.
newFloorPlan.rescaledHint_other: {{count}} points will be repositioned proportionally — the source floor plan has different dimensions than the image chosen above.
newFloorPlan.clampedHint_one: 1 point falls outside the limits of the chosen image and will be clamped to the edge — visible, but in the wrong position. Swap the image above for the original export (or one with the same dimensions) to fix it, or continue and adjust positions manually later.
newFloorPlan.clampedHint_other: {{count}} points fall outside the limits of the chosen image and will be clamped to the edge — visible, but in the wrong position. Swap the image above for the original export (or one with the same dimensions) to fix it, or continue and adjust positions manually later.

wallMeasure.title: Edge
wallMeasure.sizeLabelCalibrate: Size — real length of this edge (m), defines the floor plan scale
wallMeasure.thicknessLabelGroup_one: Thickness — stroke width (px), applied to the 1 edge in the group
wallMeasure.thicknessLabelGroup_other: Thickness — stroke width (px), applied to the {{count}} edges in the group

notice.scaleCalibrationRemoved: Scale calibration removed — the floor plan dimensions changed, recalibrate if necessary.
notice.placingPointsOn: Add-points mode on — click on the floor plan to create a measurement point. Click "Add points" again to disarm.
notice.rulerArmed: Ruler armed — click an edge for Size/Thickness, or two points on the floor plan to calibrate the scale.
notice.heatmapTooFewPoints_one: Only 1 point with this network — add at least {{min}} points for a more reliable heatmap.
notice.heatmapTooFewPoints_other: Only {{count}} points with this network — add at least {{min}} points for a more reliable heatmap.

importNotice.rescaled_one: 1 point repositioned proportionally (source floor plan dimensions differ from current).
importNotice.rescaled_other: {{count}} points repositioned proportionally (source floor plan dimensions differ from current).
importNotice.clamped_one: 1 point fell outside the floor plan limits and was clamped to the edge (no source dimensions in the CSV to rescale correctly).
importNotice.clamped_other: {{count}} points fell outside the floor plan limits and were clamped to the edge (no source dimensions in the CSV to rescale correctly).
importNotice.unmatchedFloorPlans: Floor plans not found in this survey (lines ignored): {{names}}

error.calibrationPositiveNumber: Enter a number greater than zero.
error.csvRequiresImage: Import a floor plan image before loading the readings CSV (positions depend on it).
error.wallSizeMeters: Enter a length greater than zero (meters), or leave blank to only change the thickness.
error.wallSizePx: Enter a length greater than zero (px), or leave blank to only change the thickness.
error.wallThicknessRange: Thickness must be an integer between 1 and 30.
error.csvRowColumns: Line {{line}}: expected at least {{expected}} columns, found {{found}}.
error.csvInvalidDimensions: Line {{line}}: invalid source floor-plan dimensions (width="{{width}}", height="{{height}}").
error.liveCaptureUnavailable: Live capture unavailable: preload not loaded.
error.blankFloorPlanCreate: Could not create the blank floor plan.

pointPanel.liveCaptureUnavailable: Live capture is not available on this system — use file import.
pointPanel.noReadings: No readings yet for this point.

projectSetup.title: New survey
projectSetup.hint: Create a survey. The floor plan image is optional — without one, a blank area is born (~40 m × 30 m) for drawing edges.

wallEditor.layersTitle: Layers — visibility for heatmap, measurements, image and objects
wallEditor.moveToolTitle: Move objects — select and drag vertices, walls or shapes
wallEditor.drawLineToolTitle: Draw lines — click by click, segments chain together
wallEditor.rectToolTitle: Rectangle — drag corner to corner; Shift = square
wallEditor.circleToolTitle: Circle — drag from center to edge
wallEditor.rulerTitle: Ruler — click on edge: Size/Thickness; click on floor plan: calibrate scale
wallEditor.rulerCancelTitle: Cancel ruler — click on edge measures Size/Thickness; click on floor plan calibrates scale

channelChart.title: Channel distribution
channelChart.hintExpanded_one: (1 network — hover over a shape to see details)
channelChart.hintExpanded_other: ({{count}} networks — hover over a shape to see details)

csvMapping.title: Map CSV columns
csvMapping.hint: The file format was not recognized automatically. Match each required field to the corresponding column in the file.

heatmapExport.title: Export map
heatmapExport.hint: Saves the entire floor plan with the current filters and visible layers. PNG preserves floor plan resolution; PDF fits the map on one A4 page.
heatmapExport.error: Could not export the map. Please try again.

report.title: Generate report
report.hint: The cover is always included. The map uses the current view; the chart and table include all networks in the selected band.
report.error: Could not generate the report. Please try again.
report.empty: There is no data for this section.
report.estimated: * Signal estimated from the source quality percentage.
report.scope: Map: current filters and layers. Chart and table: all networks in the selected band. Positions in pixels of the original image.

interference.title: Interference
interference.hint: Channel overlap by radio (BSSID), estimated between measured points. Green: 1-2; yellow: 3-4; red: 5+. A selected network shows overlap affecting it; All networks shows the largest overlapping group. Does not measure traffic or interference from other sources.
